title: ISO 9001:2015 QMS
description: ISO 9001:2015 certification standard that specifies requirements for a quality management system (QMS). A QMS is a set of processes that an organization uses to ensure that its products and services meet customer requirements and regulatory requirements.

template.value: The standard is published by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), a non-governmental organization that sets standards for a wide range of products, services, and processes. ISO 9001 2015 qms certification is one of the most widely used standards in the world, with over 1 million organizations certified to it.

value.subHeading: The process of implementing ISO 9001:2015 in India typically involves the following steps

steps.heading: Planning
steps.desc: The organization defines the scope of its QMS and identifies the requirements that it will need to meet

steps.heading: Implementation
steps.desc: The organization develops and implements the processes that will make up its QMS.

steps.heading: Documentation
steps.desc: The organization documents its QMS, including its policies, procedures, and records.

steps.heading: Internal audit
steps.desc: The organization conducts internal audits to ensure that its QMS is effective.

steps.heading: Management review
steps.desc: The organization's management reviews the QMS on a regular basis to ensure that it is still meeting its objectives.

steps.heading: Certification
steps.desc: The organization can then apply for certification to an accredited certification body.

steps.heading: Surveillance & Others
desc: Any organization is certified to ISO 9001:2015, it must maintain its certification by undergoing regular surveillance audits with some interval.

ISO 9001:2015 is a valuable standard that can help organizations in India improve their quality management practices and achieve their business objectives. If you are an organization in India that is interested in implementing ISO 9001:2015, contact Aanoor team to know more!

title: ISO 14001:2015 EMS
description: ISO 14001:2015 specifies requirements for Environmental Management System (EMS) for any organization that seeks to demonstrate compliance with laws and regulations, and conformity to environmental policy and stated objectives, ISO 14001: 2015 supports environmental protection and the prevention of pollution in the socio-economic balance

ISO 14001:2015 certification standard that specifies requirements for an environmental management system (EMS) for an organization. An EMS is a set of processes that an organization uses to manage its environmental impacts.

value.subHeading: The process of implementing ISO 14001:2015 in India typically involves the following steps:

steps.heading: Planning
steps.desc: The organization defines the scope of its EMS and identifies the environmental aspects that it will need to manage.

steps.heading: Implementation
steps.desc: The organization develops and implements the processes that will make up its EMS.

steps.heading: Documentation
steps.desc: The organization documents its EMS, including its policies, procedures, and records.

steps.heading: Internal audit
steps.desc: The organization conducts internal audits to ensure that its EMS is effective.

steps.heading: Management review
steps.desc: The organization's management reviews the EMS on a regular basis to ensure that it is still meeting its objectives.

steps.heading: Certification
steps.desc: The organization can then apply for certification to an accredited certification body

steps.heading: Surveillance & Others
steps.desc: Once an organization is certified to ISO 14001:2015, it must maintain its certification by undergoing regular surveillance audits. Overall, ISO 14001:2015 is a valuable standard that can help organizations in India improve their environmental performance and achieve their business objectives.

title: ISO/IEC 27001:2013 ISMS
description: ISO/IEC 27001:2013 is an international standard that provides a framework for organizations to manage their information security. The standard is based on the principles of risk-based thinking, the Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle, and management commitment.

template.value: An ISMS is a systematic approach to managing information security risks in order to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information. title: ISO 13485:2016
description: The ISO 13485:2016 standard is a valuable tool for organizations that want to demonstrate their commitment to quality and safety in the medical device industry.

value: ISO 13485:2016 is a certification standard that states requirements for a quality management system (QMS) to an organizations that design, develop, manufacture, install, and service medical devices and related services

The standard is based on the principles of risk management and the Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle. It covers all aspects of the QMS, from design and development to production, installation, and servicing.
